title: PlainGym · Free and open source gym management
name: PlainGym
eyebrow: Free and open source gym management
pitch: Run your gym on your terms, with your data on your own server.
starting: The demo is starting. Reload in a minute.
dataBody: Keep your member records and payments under your control.
standardsBody: PostgreSQL, Docker and a documented API keep your setup portable.
openBody: Read, change and share the code under the AGPL-3.0 license.
selfHostBody: Install on your own server and choose where your gym runs.
step1Body: Explore the shared showcase, then make a private copy to try changes.
step2Body: Switch between owner, coach and student without creating an account.
step3Body: Private copies expire after inactivity and are deleted within 24 hours.
billingHelp: Automatic retries include payment links; card reminders help members update expiring cards.
billingTest: The demo uses Stripe test mode; test cards move no real money.
membersLead: Keep families, contact details and member records together.
membersBullet1: One payer per household, including children
membersBullet2: Statuses, tags, photos and emergency contacts
membersAlt: A seeded member profile with household details and membership tabs
ranksLead: See who is ready for their next rank.
ranksBullet1: Belts and stripes, or kyu and dan
ranksBullet2: Criteria for classes, time at rank and age
ranksAlt: Rank settings and promotion readiness for sample members
scheduleLead: Plan the week and give members a place in class.
scheduleBullet2: Capacity limits and automatic waitlist promotion
scheduleAlt: A weekly class schedule with seeded programs and coaches
kioskLead: Let members check in at the front desk.
kioskBullet1: Use a tablet or shared screen
kioskBullet2: Name and PIN, or a QR code
kioskBullet4: Payment issues stay off the shared screen
kioskAlt: The tablet check-in screen offering QR scanning or name and PIN
portalLead: Give members an installable app for their gym.
portalBullet1: Book classes and show a check-in QR code
portalBullet3: View invoices, pay and update a card
portalBullet4: Sign waivers and manage the household
portalAlt: A sample student's rank progress in the phone-sized member portal
billingLead: Take payments through your gym's own Stripe account.
billingBullet1: Money goes to your gym; PlainGym takes no cut
billingBullet3: Signup fees, family discounts, promo codes, class packs
billingBullet5: Household invoices, manual tax, refunds, cash or check
billingAlt: Seeded membership plans showing prices, signup fees and billing periods
waiversLead: Bring the paperwork and first steps into one place.
waiversBullet1: Templates and guardian signing for minors
waiversBullet2: A PDF preserving the signed waiver
waiversBullet3: One link for card, waiver and portal invite
waiversBullet4: Card re-collection campaigns when switching systems
waiversAlt: A seeded waiver signing page with the agreement and signature fields
joinLead: Welcome new members before they reach the front desk.
joinBullet1: Public sign-up through to portal login
joinBullet3: Drop-in waivers signed ahead of class
joinAlt: The public join page with sample membership plans
reportsLead: Follow enquiries, see trends and keep members informed.
reportsBullet1: Leads board with sources and conversion
reportsBullet3: Revenue by plan, attendance by program
reportsAlt: The gym reports screen showing seeded membership and attendance data
serverLead: Run the gym on a server you control.
serverBullet1: One-command install and a setup wizard
serverBullet4: Health checks, CSV import and export
serverAlt: The Health page with the demo install's service checks
